title: colour-science/colour-checker-detection-dataset
description:
Colour - Checker Detection - Dataset
	

An image dataset of colour rendition charts.
This dataset is structured according to Ultralytics YOLO format and ready to use with YOLOv8.
The colour-science/colour-checker-detection-models models resulting from the YOLOv8 segmentation training are supporting colour rendition charts detection in the Colour Checker Detection Python package.
